name: Kurort
source:
Sun, sea, beach! An ordinary student draws a lucky ticket in the lottery and gets a trip to the resort of sunny Cyprus: the one where people with fat wallets usually vacation. Unbelieving his luck, young Miles is going to have a proper vacation before a year of hard study.

Three young beauties will help him in this: passionate and persistent Tina, fragile but determined Mirabel, and an affectionate waitress from a local cafe named Alma.

Miles, who has never received much attention from girls, finds himself surrounded by three at once. He will have to learn a lot about himself, get lost in a whirlpool of feelings and try to make a choice that will be right for him.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2720090/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
阳光、大海、沙滩！一名普通学生在彩票中抽到了一张幸运彩票，获得了前往阳光明媚的塞浦路斯度假胜地的机会：那里是钱包充裕的人通常度假的地方。令人难以置信的是，年轻的迈尔斯在一年的刻苦学习之前将有一个适当的假期。

三位年轻美女将在这方面帮助他：热情而执着的蒂娜，脆弱但坚定的米拉贝尔，以及当地一家咖啡馆的热情女服务员阿尔玛。

迈尔斯从来没有受到过太多女孩的关注，但他发现自己同时被三个女孩包围。他必须更多地了解自己，迷失在感情的漩涡中，并尝试做出适合他的选择。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2720090/]Steam[/url]]
